The '''Ghothia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Ghothian slime pool]]s.<ref name="ImperialSourcebook">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ghothian slime pool]]|system=Ghothia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghothia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square I-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
